scale.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/fa.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "1000000000: << میلیارد" and "1000000000000: << هزار میلیارد"; no Persian scale word changes its value between the scales.

group_mark.source: CLDR main/fa.xml, latn symbols inherited from root: group ",".

decimal_mark.source: CLDR main/fa.xml, latn symbols inherited from root: decimal ".".

space_groups.source: CLDR main/fa.xml groups digits with a mark, not a space.

plural_scale_needs_count.source: Dehkhoda, Loghatnameh (لغت‌نامهٔ دهخدا), entry "هزاران": thousands of, no number.

scale_noun_agrees.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/fa.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "1000000: << میلیون[ و >>]": میلیون keeps the singular after every count.

joiner_tens_units.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/fa.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "20: بیست[ و >>]".

joiner_after_hundred.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/fa.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "100: صد[ و >>]".

joiner_between_groups.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/fa.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "1000: << هزار[ و >>]".

joiner_before_round_hundred.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/fa.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "1000: << هزار[ و >>]": و goes before any rest after a thousand, a round hundred too.

ordinal_style.source: Anvari and Givi, Dastur-e zaban-e farsi (دستور زبان فارسی), chapter on numerals (عدد): the ordinal suffix -م goes on the last word ("بیست و یکم").

fold_marks.source: Persian is written with or without short-vowel marks; they never change which number a word names.

letter_folds.source: Persian text typed on an Arabic keyboard has Arabic yeh (U+064A) and kaf (U+0643) for Persian ی (U+06CC) and ک (U+06A9); both read the same.

word_chars.source: Anvari and Givi, Dastur-e zaban-e farsi (دستور زبان فارسی), chapter on numerals (عدد): the zero-width non-joiner stands inside a word ("سی‌ام", "میلیون‌ها"); a word reads the same with or without it.

bidi_controls.source: CLDR main/fa.xml writes the minus sign as "\u200e−": directional marks stand next to numbers in right-to-left text.

native_digits.source: CLDR common/supplemental/numberingSystems.xml: arabext digits ۰-۹ (U+06F0-U+06F9), the default of fa, and arab digits ٠-٩; CLDR root arabext symbols: decimal "٫" (U+066B), group "٬" (U+066C).

range_cue.source: Dehkhoda, Loghatnameh (لغت‌نامهٔ دهخدا), entry "بین": between; in "بین ده و بیست" the "و" links the two limits.

article_one.source: Anvari and Givi, Dastur-e zaban-e farsi (دستور زبان فارسی), chapter on numerals (عدد): "یک" before a noun also marks it indefinite ("یک کتاب").

minus_idioms.source: Persian uses no such word in a number.

of.source: Persian uses no such word in a number.

fraction_of.source: Persian uses no such word in a number.

denominator_particle.source: Persian uses no such word in a number.
